I've replied to Pree in her thread in #central-team: the store is **Pine Crossing**.

On 9 June she posted in #central-team that Pine Crossing's morning receiver saw only the afternoon shift on the appointment screen. That came up after a driver arrived at 7:10. Hollis said then that he'd check the shift template.

I couldn't find an address or site code for Pine Crossing. The thread doesn't give one, and there are no Marrow Agrisupply account files she or I can open. If the account sheet needs more than the store name, she'll have to ask Marrow's store ops.
